# Three.js 0.160.1

Vendored ES module from https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.1/build/three.module.js,
with the upstream MIT LICENSE from the same pinned package. This is a 3D graphics
library, not a neural model. Loaded locally; no CDN requests at runtime.

Official renderer reference: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html.
The film uses PerspectiveCamera, geometric meshes, lights and deterministic
transforms. Text labels are drawn locally as texture labels; they are not input
photos or slides. All visible scene geometry moves in a single continuous take.
